subject: Error while running R-SWAT on linux

messages.author: b3d8e4314e11967d
messages.subject: Error while running R-SWAT on linux
parts:
Hi.

I tried to run R-SWAT for SWAT model. After setting al the parameters and the number of simulations to be done, the system seems to work correctly and once the simulations finished the system displays a list of parameters that fitted the range defined.
However the files on the Output/CoreX folders show that all simulations have been done with the same set of parameters (the one in the first row of the parameter list).
The latest version have another problem in addition, it doesn't allow to include the observation variable file and show an error message (the RStudio show the following warning message: Warning: Unknown or uninitialised column: `path`)

Best regards.
Luis
